acceptance_assertions: boundary 1 (Product API): real Gateway HTTP task/grant/plan responses; plan stage is strategy_draft.

boundary 2 (Adapter): the authenticated internal route returns a real receipt with a server-derived call_identity and dsh_run_id; the request body carries no routing/identity; unauthenticated and forged-token callers are rejected before any admission.
boundary 3 (DSH): the real carrier invoked the bounded child persona with exactly the five read-only tools (already proven by carrier-turn-runner.v1.json); the adapter call must produce the same.

boundary 4 (Backend): the research_judgment_stage_calls row is admitted then completed for that exact call_identity; a proposal is committed atomically or the admission fails closed; no duplicate objects.
model non-choices: no next_action/identity/approval/idempotency/routing/recovery in any observed model-visible tool or request.
no model-visible raw/full signal snapshot, bars/frame/date_index, or full execution snapshot.

exactly_once_across_interrupts.attempt_authority: the trusted caller supplies x-byq-judgment-attempt = persisted plan version:stage:iteration; a NEW call rejects a stale/forged/future attempt binding before creating any stage call (no budget consumption); a COMPLETED call is replayed by identity regardless of the binding.

concurrency.behavior: a duplicate/concurrent request for a live attempt returns 409 research_judgment_in_progress and writes NOTHING; the original owner's real proposal is the only result committed
concurrency.follow_up: a verifiable durable attempt lease (owner + expiry) is required before safe convergence/abandonment; until then fail closed without mutating business state
concurrency.no_recovery_claim: there is no verifiable lease/receipt proving the original owner died, so a genuinely dead in-flight attempt stays admitted and is NOT auto-converged; real cross-process resume is NOT implemented or claimed, and the corresponding fault-matrix row stays not-passed

exactly_once_across_interrupts.defect: the adapter always ran the turn_runner after admit; a retry of a call that had already committed its result (lost response, or a late retry after the plan advanced) ran a second paid DSH/provider turn. A follow-up defect fenced any duplicate in-flight admission to needs_attention, which a concurrent request could use to terminate a live turn. A third defect checked the attempt binding before the completed replay, so a late retry after the plan advanced never reached the stored receipt.
exactly_once_across_interrupts.fix: admit checks the COMPLETED call FIRST (idempotent replay of the stored receipt, before any attempt/current-plan check), so a late retry with the old attempt returns the original receipt even after the plan advanced; only then does it validate the attempt binding against the current plan and create a call. The adapter returns the stored receipt for completed calls; for an existing in-flight admission it does NOT terminate or mutate the turn but fails closed with ResearchJudgmentInProgress (HTTP 409) because no cross-process lease exists to prove the old owner is terminal.
reproduction: services/backend/tests/test_research_judgment.py: an actually-advancing proposal (backtest_analysis -> iteration_comparison) then a late retry with the OLD attempt returns the original receipt, adds NO stage call and leaves the plan unchanged; forged/stale/future attempts add no row

services/runtime-adapter/tests/test_research_judgment.py: completed admission => stored receipt with no model turn; in-flight duplicate => ResearchJudgmentInProgress with no result write; an overlapping concurrent duplicate cannot preempt the original proposal
services/runtime-adapter/tests/test_research_judgment_turn.py: any non-none durable_evidence from the child fails closed
tests/test_research_judgment_contract.py: optional attempt binding is closed/validated; first call without durable progress cannot continue
exactly_once_across_interrupts.second_call_reachability: a stage's second model call requires model-supplied durable progress (artifact/experiment/backtest_job). The bounded judgment adapter may NOT supply a durable evidence identity (extract_closed_result fails closed on any non-none durable_evidence) and the persona has no write tool, so the second call is unreachable through this adapter; the identity plan_version:stage:iteration therefore covers the single judgment call per stage/iteration. A future continue-second-call flow needs an explicit durable attempt discriminator.

purpose: ADR-0085 P4: inventory the real Product API -> Runtime Adapter -> DSH -> Backend seam, define the authenticated minimal trusted entry and its acceptance assertions, and honestly record what is proven vs not yet executed.

resolved_blockers.resolution: compose.p4-judgment.yml adds a dedicated read-only MCP service (subset=1, port 8301, dedicated token)
scripts/v091/continuation_p4/judgment_scripted_provider.py emits the persona tool call and the closed child JSON
the P4 driver uses its own worktree-local compose override and never the composite F6 /tmp/opencode path
existing D15 images reused with the current tree bind-mounted; no heavy rebuild needed
the trusted Backend plan-creation seam now derives plan references from the persisted grant's confirmed validated artifacts (server-side, no model identity)

retry_idempotency.defect: the first authenticated version generated a fresh call_identity (uuid4) per POST, so an admit that succeeded but lost its result (adapter restart/timeout) created a second stage_call and consumed the stage's second model-call slot, breaking the exact-budget and no-duplicate acceptance.
retry_idempotency.fix: the durable call_identity is now derived server-side from task_id + the persisted plan's version/stage/iteration supplied by the authenticated service (x-byq-judgment-attempt); a retry of the same logical turn reuses the same identity and the Backend admission replays for free, while a legitimate new stage/plan revision/iteration gets a new identity.
retry_idempotency.generation_honesty: the adapter response labels the per-request value as adapter_invocation.id and reports dsh_generation.status=not_available; no mapping to a persisted RuntimeGeneration is claimed
reproduction: services/runtime-adapter/tests/test_research_judgment_boundary.py: derivation is deterministic and attempt-scoped, attempt binding is required/exact

services/runtime-adapter/tests/test_research_judgment_api.py (runtime image): two POSTs with the same attempt reuse one call_identity; a changed attempt gets a new one; a missing attempt is rejected before admission

services/backend/tests/test_research_judgment.py::test_stage_call_retry_after_interruption_reuses_the_same_attempt_identity (isolated PostgreSQL): stable identity => 1 stage_call row and call_index 1 on retry; a fresh identity would take call_index 2 and a third would be refused

security_review_remediation.driver_reaudit: the driver no longer sends dsh_run_id=session_id+'-p4'; it sends the real conversation runtime_session_id as context and records the adapter-returned server-derived dsh_run_id and call_identity in the raw judgment evidence
security_review_remediation.finding: the earlier route trusted arbitrary x-byq-* headers and derived call_identity from forgeable header values, so a non-trusted caller could trigger admission/model calls
security_review_remediation.fix: added shared service-token authentication (401/503 before any entry call), server-generated call_identity and dsh_run_id, and documented that the authoritative task/owner/workspace/stage binding is the Backend admission transaction
security_review_remediation.threat_reproduction: services/runtime-adapter/tests/test_research_judgment_api.py: no token => 401, forged token => 401, disabled => 503, incomplete context => 401, and in every rejected case a spy proves run_stage_judgment (admission/model turn) was NOT reached; the accepted case shows call_identity/dsh_run_id are server-derived and never equal a caller header/body value
